latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — quickly edit and export images with zero manual adjustments.

- Upload images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, up to 200MB) and describe your desired edits; the system handles everything else.
- Automatically removes backgrounds, adds backdrops, and exports polished results as 1080p MP4 or standard image formats.
- No need for paid software or manual tweaking; ideal for bloggers, small businesses, and social media creators.
- Session-based workflow with 100 free credits per week—supports batch edits, session previews, and multi-step refinements.
- Clear error handling, authentication flow, and credits management built in for a smooth experience.
